headline: Impeachment Court Set to Reconvene for Day 17 With Cash-Advance Custodians
seoTitle: Impeachment Day 17: Cash-Advance Custodians Set to Testify | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News morning brief reports that the Senate Impeachment Court was set to reconvene for Day 17 with witnesses tied to confidential-fund cash advances.
deck: The planned resumption follows a weather-related delay and returns attention to financial records and custody of cash advances.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News 7:00 AM package reports that the Senate Impeachment Court was scheduled to resume Day 17 at 9:00 AM on August 19 after the previous day's weather postponement.

The package says prosecutors planned to present internal cash-advance custodians and administrative staff regarding vouchers, encashment schedules and custody records connected to ₱125 million in confidential funds.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The testimony was part of an ongoing evidentiary process. Claims and interpretations advanced by either side are not treated as established facts unless supported by evidence accepted by the court.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Witness testimony about financial custody and documentation may affect how senator-judges assess disputed confidential-fund transactions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the Senate for the actual session status, witness appearances, cross-examination and evidentiary rulings.
